name: Story of Seasons: Grand Bazaar Digital Artbook and Soundtrack
description:
A Digital Artbook and Soundtrack App featuring 115 pages of exclusive artwork, including illustrations of characters, animals, and development materials. Enjoy all 66 music tracks from STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar at your leisure.

Please note: The Digital Artbook and Soundtrack App is a separate application from the main game.
intro: Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar
